tasks.question: Using Sanofi's reported 2025 gross market-based Scope 1, gross market-based Scope 2 and significant Scope 3 GHG emissions, calculate their sum and compare it with the disclosed total GHG emissions for the transition-plan scope, retaining the reported ktCO2e unit and explaining any exact or rounding difference.

What near-term and net-zero GHG targets does Sanofi report, including base year, Scope 1 and 2 and Scope 3 reduction percentages and years, covered Scope 3 categories, SBTi status following the Opella divestment, treatment of residual emissions, and reported 2025 progress?

What 2025 air-pollution and substances-of-very-high-concern results does Sanofi report for VOCs, dichloromethane and SVHCs, and what site, solvent-use, threshold, measurement and substance-list boundaries qualify those indicators?

What 2025 own-workforce safety results does Sanofi report for management-system coverage, fatalities, recordable accidents, recordable-accident rate, recordable ill-health cases, lost-time injury frequency and serious injuries, including the stated denominators, voluntary-status notes and December-hours estimate?

What 2025 cumulative Global Health Unit results does Sanofi report for NCD partnerships, countries supported, beneficiaries reached, healthcare professionals and workers engaged, and supply-chain facilities upskilled, and what period and restatement qualifications define these indicators?

What sustainability and EU Taxonomy information is covered by Sanofi's statutory auditors' limited-assurance report, what three conclusions are stated, which professional guidance governs the work, and what comparative-period, forward-looking and assurance-level limitations apply?
